status: Nine-case profile turnaround measured284.0878s; independent-pair precision measured separately, not universal five-minute significance
scope: Fixed core plus predeclared primary scenarios and conditional diagnostic companions. Representative prioritization, not full52 promotion.

snapshot_core.purpose: Two supports, bending and alternative load paths
Long sparse load path and slow equilibrium propagation
Tall looped structure and long-range convergence
Moderate-scale first fracture, correction and second stress
Large authored state and first-use equilibrium work
Large fragmented population, contact pressure and further fracture

continuous_core.purpose: Naturally warm intact equilibrium, sleeping and unchanged-input work
Current-contact destruction through first impact, repeated fractures and active debris

profile_policy.systems: One affected full tick with complete CPU/GPU timeline; second only if budget permits
profile_policy.ncu: One or two representative launches with hypothesis-specific counters when the mechanism needs them
profile_policy.reference: Reuse matching frozen baseline profiles; do not pool profiler timings with production latency

noise_policy.confirmation: Freeze primary outcomes, practical margins and fixed independent-pair count before candidate confirmation. Require adjusted confidence bounds to establish improvement or equivalence; a crossing interval requires further planned measurement and no promotion.
noise_policy.no_automatic_significance: No sample-level bootstrap confidence claim; two candidate blocks do not establish a precise confidence interval
noise_policy.first_use: Retain every first-use tick and report first-use versus subsequent samples separately
noise_policy.adaptive: Predeclare primary cases; new focused confirmation is a separate complete balanced block, not repeated testing until a favorable p-value

finalist: Full52 plus required continuous, physical, numerical and memory gates; no dropped workloads or relaxed tolerances
